verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own audit log: every write operation, including agent approvals and edits, "lands in the customer's Ramp audit log automatically," and an audit_logs:read scope is exposed on the MCP server, alongside documented policy-grounded approval workflows. However, the audit-log evidence comes almost entirely from the AI-agent guides, and nothing shows a per-expense trail that ties together edit history, approval chain and policy-check results. missing for 10: per-expense audit trail documentation covering edits/approvals/policy checks together, retention or immutability guarantees, auditor-ready export, independent or hands-on corroboration of external-audit suitability.
